description:
A 4-panel spin-off webtoon that collects the cute and lovely stories of the characters in [Under the Oak Tree](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=22856385000).

[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/5138000001)

**Official Translations:**  
[English**](https://manta.net/en/series/under-the-oak-tree?seriesId=1255), [Spanish**](https://manta.net/es/series/under-the-oak-tree?seriesId=2185), [Japanese](https://mechacomic.jp/books/214202) 

***The chapters are combined with the main story and named as 'Mini Episodes'/'Mini Capítulo' on Manta. Also Manta split the chapters in half in their translations.*
